urls.rationale: Political Reform Act Title 9 Ch. 6 (Lobbyists), §§ 86100-86300 — core lobbying registration and disclosure body.
Title 9 Ch. 2 (Definitions, §§ 82000-82054) — Political Reform Act-wide definitions (e.g., 'lobbyist', 'lobbying firm', 'lobbyist employer') that the Ch. 6 substantive rules depend on.
Title 9 Ch. 11 (Enforcement, §§ 91000-91014) — Political Reform Act penalty and enforcement provisions cross-referenced by the lobbying chapter.

notes: CA's Gov Code title-page snapshot exposes title-level URLs only (not chapter URLs). One intermediate fetch on title-9/ was required to surface the Political Reform Act's chapter list. Tree depth at this layer = 3 (code -> title -> chapter); pass-3 will descend to article/range-leaf pages.
